```{r load libraries}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(PNWColors)
library(ggtranscript)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rtracklayer)
library(biomaRt)
```

```{r load data}
# load bedtools intersect results: HERVdb, flair gtf
herv_int_50<- read.table("herv_intersect_50ov.bed", sep = "\t") %>% filter(V15 == "gene")

# load flair quant counts
counts<-read.table("flair_quant.counts.tsv")
```

```{r plot isoform usage}
herv<- ""
isos<- herv_int_50 %>% filter(str_detect(V21, herv)) %>% dplyr::select(V4)
subcounts<- counts %>% filter(ids %in% isos$V4)

colnames(subcounts)
subcounts<- pivot_longer(subcounts, cols= -ids)
subcounts <- subcounts %>% mutate(condition = str_extract(name, "_.*_"))
subcounts$condition<- gsub("healthy", "normal", subcounts$condition)
subcounts$condition<- gsub("_", "", subcounts$condition)

subcounts <- subcounts %>% mutate(sample = str_extract(name, "^K\\d+\\w")) %>%  mutate(pt = str_extract(name, "^K\\d+")) %>% filter(!str_detect(name,"depleted")) %>% na.omit()

### expression

pal<- pnw_palette("Sailboat", 5)

df_plot <- subcounts %>%
  mutate(value_signed = ifelse(condition == "normal", -value, value))

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = sample, y = value_signed, fill = ids)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3,
           position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1)),
    limits = c(-max(df_plot$value), max(df_plot$value)),
    labels = function(x) abs(x)
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,  label = "Tumor",  hjust = -0.2, vjust = 1.5) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf, label = "Normal", hjust = -0.2, vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(x = "Patient", y = "Expression",
       fill = "Isoform", title = paste0( herv)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 30) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

```

```{r plot isoforms}
gtf <- import("SK031_combined.gtf")

exons <- as.data.frame(gtf) %>%
  filter(type == "exon") %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end, strand, transcript_id, gene_id)

 
exons_sub <- exons %>%
  filter(str_detect(transcript_id, "43635-1_ENST00000647830.2_6"))
 

introns_sub <- to_intron(exons_sub, group_var = "transcript_id")
 
### plot 

p <- ggplot(exons_sub, aes(
  xstart = start, xend = end, y = transcript_id
)) +
  geom_range(
    aes(fill = gene_id),
    height = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_intron(
    data = introns_sub,
    aes(strand = strand),
    arrow.min.intron.length = 200
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_id, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic position",
    title = paste("Transcript models")
  )
 
print(p)

```


```{r with ref genes}

ref_gtf <- import("ref.gtf")
ref_gtf_df <- as.data.frame(ref_gtf)

ref_gtf_df <- ref_gtf_df %>%
  mutate(gene_name = ifelse(is.na(gene_name) | gene_name == "", gene_id, gene_name))


ref_exons_true <- ref_gtf_df %>%
  filter(type == "exon") %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end, strand, transcript_id, gene_name)

# For transcripts with NO exon rows at all
#    fall back to using the transcript-level row itself as one exon block
transcripts_with_exons <- unique(ref_exons_true$transcript_id)

ref_exons_fallback <- ref_gtf_df %>%
  filter(type == "transcript", !transcript_id %in% transcripts_with_exons) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end, strand, transcript_id, gene_name)

ref_exons_all <- bind_rows(ref_exons_true, ref_exons_fallback)

# --- Specify the two genes novel transcript spans ---
spanned_genes <- c("RBRT304117", "CERNA2")

# checks 
unique(ref_gtf_df$gene_name)[grepl("RBRT304117", unique(ref_gtf_df$gene_name), ignore.case = TRUE)]
unique(ref_gtf_df$gene_id)[grepl("RBRT304117", unique(ref_gtf_df$gene_id), ignore.case = TRUE)]

ref_gtf_df %>% filter(gene_id == "RBRT304117" | gene_name == "RBRT304117") %>% dplyr::select(type, start, end, gene_id, gene_name)


### specifying the transcript 
## filter
ref_gtf_tx <- ref_gtf_df %>% filter(gene_name == spanned_genes[2] & type == "transcript")
## manually choose ref tx
ref_exons_rep <- ref_exons_all %>% filter(transcript_id %in% "ENST00000398733.8_8" | gene_name == spanned_genes[1])

unique(ref_exons_rep$gene_name)

exons_sub$source <- "FLAIR (novel)"
ref_exons_rep$source <- "Reference"

exons_sub$gene_name <- paste(spanned_genes, collapse = " / ")

combined_exons <- bind_rows(exons_sub, ref_exons_rep)

# --- Derive introns for the combined set ---
combined_introns <- to_intron(combined_exons, group_var = "transcript_id")

tx_to_gene <- combined_exons %>% distinct(transcript_id, gene_name)
combined_introns <- combined_introns %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of("gene_name")) %>%
  left_join(tx_to_gene, by = "transcript_id")

# --- Order rows: novel transcript first, then the two reference genes ---
gene_order <- c(unique(exons_sub$gene_name), spanned_genes)
combined_exons$gene_name <- factor(combined_exons$gene_name, levels = gene_order)
combined_introns$gene_name <- factor(combined_introns$gene_name, levels = gene_order)

# --- Plot: single genomic-coordinate x-axis so the spanning relationship
p_span <- ggplot(combined_exons, aes(
  xstart = start, xend = end, y = gene_name
)) +
  geom_range(aes(fill = source), height = 0.25) +
  geom_intron(
    data = combined_introns,
    aes(strand = strand),
    arrow.min.intron.length = 200
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FLAIR (novel)" = "#6e7cb9", "Reference" = "navyblue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic position (chr10) ",
    title =""
  )

print(p_span)

```

```{r version with additional HERV transcripts}
herv<- ""

isos <- herv_int_50 %>%
  filter(str_detect(V21, herv)) %>%
  pull(V4) %>%
  unique()

isos

transcript_ids_clean <- str_replace(isos, "_[^_]+$", "")

## Pull exon structure for these isoforms from the FLAIR-derived `exons` df
iso_exons <- exons %>%
  filter(transcript_id %in% transcript_ids_clean ) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end, strand, transcript_id, gene_id)

iso_exons$source <- "Isoform"

## ref_exons_rep already has source = "Reference" from the chunk above
combined_all <- bind_rows(ref_exons_rep, iso_exons)

combined_all_introns <- to_intron(combined_all, group_var = "transcript_id")

tx_to_group <- combined_all %>% distinct(transcript_id, gene_name, source)
combined_all_introns <- combined_all_introns %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("gene_name", "source"))) %>%
  left_join(tx_to_group, by = "transcript_id")

## Row identity: reference genes plot by gene_name, isoforms plot by transcript_id
combined_all <- combined_all %>%
  mutate(plot_row = if_else(source == "Reference", gene_name, transcript_id))
combined_all_introns <- combined_all_introns %>%
  mutate(plot_row = if_else(source == "Reference", gene_name, transcript_id))

## Order: reference genes on top, then isoforms below
row_order <- c(spanned_genes, sort(unique(iso_exons$transcript_id)))
combined_all$plot_row <- factor(combined_all$plot_row, levels = rev(row_order))
combined_all_introns$plot_row <- factor(combined_all_introns$plot_row, levels = rev(row_order))

combined_all <- combined_all %>%
  mutate(plot_row_label = str_trunc(as.character(plot_row), width = 15, side = "right"))

combined_all_introns <- combined_all_introns %>%
  mutate(plot_row_label = str_trunc(as.character(plot_row), width = 15, side = "right"))

# Keep the same ordering, but apply it to the new truncated label column
truncated_order <- str_trunc(row_order, width = 15, side = "right")
combined_all$plot_row_label <- factor(combined_all$plot_row_label, levels = rev(truncated_order))
combined_all_introns$plot_row_label <- factor(combined_all_introns$plot_row_label, levels = rev(truncated_order))

p_isoforms <- ggplot(combined_all, aes(xstart = start, xend = end, y = plot_row_label)) +
  geom_range(aes(fill = source), height = 0.25) +
  geom_intron(data = combined_all_introns, aes(strand = strand),
              arrow.min.intron.length = 200) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Reference" = "navyblue", "Isoform" = "#6e7cb9")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Genomic position", title = "")

print(p_isoforms)
```
